study_scope: S-only causal persistence-residual forecasting; no external covariates or historical financial release inputs

context_baselines.seasonal_naive: available only when the configured period P is no longer than the causal input history
context_baselines.dlinear: learned contextual baseline with the same input length, maximum horizon, seed set, optimizer, early stopping, and training samples as M1-M3

statistical_selection.selection_metric: mean path RMSE on at most 20 fixed non-overlapping validation origins per series
statistical_selection.fit_failure_fallback: persistence for that origin, with failure retained in failures.csv

state_features.change_score: max(abs(latest_level_z), abs(first_difference_z), abs(second_difference_z), abs(short_trend_z), volatility_ratio, max_abs_jump_z, abs(seasonal_deviation_z))
state_features.missing_rule: never use a future value; windows with unresolved values are ineligible

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm across H1, H2, stable safety at four horizons

amendment.reason: v1.0-v1.5 corrections are retained in their archived locks. v1.6 began real runs after a complete lock, but the compact synthetic export subsequently corrected its protocol-lock mapping. Because task manifests intentionally hash the complete SAPR implementation, including the export script, v1.6 real tasks would contain two code hashes. No complete v1.6 real matrix was produced.
amendment.correction: Freeze the final real matrix after the corrected export implementation is in place. Retain all partial v1.6 real artifacts, task manifests, data, and lock under explicit mismatch labels; do not combine them with v1.7 results.
